subject: Post-call: VPC & air-gap constraints for Medidata — next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Liang <anna.liang@medidata.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: VPC + air-gap constraints (Medidata)

Hi Anna — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same context. Please flag anything I missed.

Call summary (high level):
- Drivers: HIPAA with state-level residency constraints (some PHI must remain in a US-based VPC) and an upcoming audit next quarter that is pushing a hard timeline.
- Requirement: Air-gapped/inbound-blocked deployment pattern for some internal ML pipelines; customer-managed NAT/firewall with no outbound internet from the pod.
- Network specifics: Static IPs for egress allowed only through your managed NAT, mutual TLS for control plane, TLS termination pinned to customer certs, and strict CIDR allowlists between app and data VLANs.
- Data residency: Logs and model telemetry must stay in the customer VPC and be retained per your policy; we discussed optional token-level masking and disabled telemetry for regulated workloads.
- Timeline: pilot environment requested within 6 weeks; production target in ~3 months contingent on security approvals.

Open questions from today (for Medidata input):
1) Can you confirm which subnets will be used for worker vs control-plane traffic and whether those subnets are routable to the prod data store?
2) Will your security team allow the outbound connection to Redwood control plane for telemetry by exception, or do we need to support a fully air-gapped control plane (no outbound)?
3) Any preferred cipher suites / mTLS CA for certificate exchange?
4) Who should receive the SOC2 evidence packet and password-protected artifact drops?

Attachments: I attached a short networking checklist and a template for the air-gap requirements we discussed.

Proposed next steps (our side):
- Deliver an annotated network diagram + suggested SG/NACL rules (by Thu 2026-09-17).
- Prepare a scoped Private deployment quote and pilot SOW (by Mon 2026-09-21).
- Schedule a 30-minute security deep-dive with your SecOps + our infra engineering (suggest Thu 2026-09-16 or Mon 2026-09-20).

Please reply with availability for the deep-dive and the answers to the open questions. If anything above is off, I’ll update and redistribute.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: VPC + air-gap constraints (Medidata)

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the crisp summary. Couple quick clarifications and answers inline: 

> 1) Subnets for worker vs control-plane
We will use: 10.12.8.0/24 for ML workers (data access allowed), 10.12.9.0/26 for control-plane. Workers can reach our prod data store over the transit gateway; control-plane cannot, by policy.

> 2) Outbound connection for telemetry
Short answer: we cannot authorize persistent outbound connections to a third-party control plane for regulated workloads. For the pilot, we can allow point-in-time uploads via an internal jumpbox (SCP to a secure bucket) or a dedicated SFTP endpoint. Fully air-gapped control plane is preferred for HIPAA-scoped workflows.

> 3) Preferred cipher / mTLS CA
We use our internal PKI (Entrust) and will provide cert bundles. Mutual TLS with certificate pinning is required.

> 4) SOC2 evidence packet recipient
Send to samir.patel@medidata.com and security_evidence@medidata.com (we’ll create a ticket and share an intake link).

Availability: Thu 2026-09-16 09:00–10:00 PT works for our SecOps director.

We’ll also send our data-retention policy and a redacted architecture diagram before the meeting.

Best,
Anna

Anna Liang

Looping in Vivek for technical alignment. Quick notes / asks before the SecOps call: 
- We need to confirm whether the pilot can accept a transient upload pattern for logs/metrics (SFTP/jumpbox) vs full suppression of telemetry. If transient uploads are acceptable, we can avoid building a private control-plane for the pilot.
- Vivek: can you prepare a short checklist for cert exchange and a minimal PKI compatibility matrix (Entrust + our client auth flow)?
- Also: cost note — fully air-gapped, customer-managed control-plane will change the SOW (additional infra and ops fee). Priyom, flag as "SOW delta" in the proposed quote.

2) Annotated network diagram + SG/NACL suggestions — deliver by Thu 2026-09-17. Owner: Vivek. (I’ll share the template we use.)
